notApplicable.size: All public named sizes are listed. Open numeric/string dimensions use documented representative samples, not an exhaustive claim.
notApplicable.density: All three layout density boundaries are exercised independently of size.
notApplicable.selection: This display/feedback component has no selected or checked protocol.
notApplicable.error: Errors belong to the owning data/action flow, not an invented presentation state.
notApplicable.interaction: Hover/focus/press apply only to the genuine public interactive control, never to the display surface.
notApplicable.motion: Continuous states are recorded naturally with video/time-series in a separate file; they are never frozen into a static pixel baseline.
